annotation.title_clean: Council Directive 87/358/EEC of 25 June 1987 amending Directive 70/156/EEC on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to the type-approval of motor vehicles and their trailers
annotation.title_en: Council Directive 87/358/EEC of 25 June 1987 amending Directive 70/156/EEC on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to the type-approval of motor vehicles and their trailers
annotation.summary_en: 1987 Council Directive amending Directive 70/156/EEC on EEC type-approval of motor vehicles and trailers. It defines vehicles, separate technical units and components, strengthens conformity-of-production checks, clarifies procedures between Member States, and sets certificate-of-conformity rules. Not AI-related; conventional vehicle type-approval.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines vehicle, separate technical unit and component for type-approval
Member States must verify conformity of production and run spot checks
Type-approval certificates must be shared with other Member States within one month
Procedure for disputes and withdrawal of type-approval for non-conforming vehicles
Member States to transpose by 1 October 1988
